<html lang="ko" data-motion="full"><head>

<meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"><title>GSPEC synthetic bridge observation</title><link rel="stylesheet" href="/architecture/ui/fonts/fonts.css"><style type="text/css" data-vite-dev-id="C:/Users/user/Desktop/universal_reviewer/src/visual-contract/eager.css">@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Noto+Sans+KR:wght@400;450;500;550;600;650;700&display=swap');.golden-picker {
  width: min(940px, 94vw);
  height: min(820px, 92dvh);
  max-height: 94dvh;
  padding: 0;
  margin: auto;
  border: 1px solid #343d44;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: #10151a;
  color: #eef2f3;
  box-shadow: 0 30px 110px #000a;
  font-family: inherit;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.golden-picker::backdrop {
  background: #030608b8;
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
}
.golden-picker *, .golden-picker *::before, .golden-picker *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.golden-picker button, .golden-picker select, .golden-picker input {
  font: inherit;
}
.golden-picker button {
  cursor: pointer;
}
.golden-picker button:disabled {
  cursor: default;
  opacity: .5;
}
.golden-picker button:focus-visible, .golden-picker select:focus-visible, .golden-picker input:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #c5f65d;
  outline-offset: 3px;
}
.golden-picker-shell {
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 0;
}
.golden-picker-header {
  display: flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 15px;
  padding: 23px 25px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #283139;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 4% 0%, #29341d8c, transparent 65%);
}
.golden-picker-emblem {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border: 1px solid #c5f65d42;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: #c5f65d0c;
  color: #c5f65d;
}
.golden-picker-eyebrow {
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #a9cc74;
}
.golden-picker-header h2 {
  margin: 5px 0;
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 650;
  letter-spacing: -.7px;
}
.golden-picker-header p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #98a5af;
}
.golden-picker-close {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  margin-left: auto;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: #ffffff06;
  color: #94a0aa;
}
.golden-picker-close:hover {
  color: white;
  background: #ffffff10;
}
.golden-picker-body {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 160px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.golden-picker-mode-criteria, .golden-picker-mode-target {
  width: min(600px, 94vw);
}
.golden-picker-mode-criteria .golden-picker-body, .golden-picker-mode-target .golden-picker-body {
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
}
.golden-picker-mode-criteria .golden-picker-entry, .golden-picker-mode-target .golden-picker-entry {
  min-height: 38px;
}
.golden-picker-panel {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 0;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 18px 18px 12px;
}
.golden-picker-panel + .golden-picker-panel {
  border-left: 1px solid #283139;
}
.golden-picker-section-title {
  display: flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 0 3px 12px;
  color: #aebbc4;
}
.golden-picker-section-title > span {
  color: #64717b;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-right: 1px;
}
.golden-picker-section-title h3 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #e0e7ec;
}
.golden-picker-section-title small {
  margin-left: auto;
  color: #788894;
  font-size: 10px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.golden-picker-list {
  overflow-y: auto;
  min-height: 0;
  padding: 1px 6px 2px 1px;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: #34404a transparent;
}
.golden-picker-entry {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  min-height: 34px;
  padding: 8px 9px;
  margin: 3px 0;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background .16s, border-color .16s;
}
.golden-picker-entry:hover {
  background: #ffffff05;
}
.golden-picker-entry.is-selected {
  border-color: #c5f65d3d;
  background: #c5f65d0b;
}
.golden-picker-entry input {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  opacity: 0;
}
.golden-picker-entry:has(input:focus-visible) {
  outline: 2px solid #c5f65d;
  outline-offset: 0;
}
.golden-picker-entry:has(input:disabled) {
  opacity: .45;
  cursor: default;
}
.golden-picker-marker {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  border: 1px solid #48545c;
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: #12180d;
}
.golden-picker-entry input[type='radio'] + .golden-picker-marker {
  border-radius: 50%;
}
.is-selected .golden-picker-marker {
  border-color: #c5f65d;
  background: #c5f65d;
}
.golden-picker-entry strong {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #7a909e;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.golden-picker-entry.is-selected strong {
  color: #b3d786;
}
.golden-picker-entry-description {
  color: #b5c0c8;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.golden-picker-entry.is-selected .golden-picker-entry-description {
  color: #eef3e6;
}
.golden-picker-notice-dot {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 5px;
  height: 5px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #eec678;
  margin-left: auto;
}
.golden-picker-format {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  gap: 7px;
  padding: 0 1px 8px;
}
.golden-picker-format button {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  width: 50%;
  border: 1px solid #34404a;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 9px 6px;
  background: #0b1015;
  color: #82939f;
  font-size: 11px;
}
.golden-picker-format button span {
  font-size: 10px;
}
.golden-picker-format button[aria-pressed='true'] {
  border-color: #69ddeb70;
  background: #69ddeb0a;
  color: #9feaf3;
}
.golden-picker-ledger {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 15px;
  border-top: 1px solid #283139;
  padding: 14px 24px;
  background: #0e1318;
}
.golden-picker-ledger > div {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  color: #8ca4b2;
}
.golden-picker-ledger h3 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #b8c5ce;
}
.golden-picker-ledger small {
  color: #6f8290;
  font-size: 10px;
}
.golden-picker-ledger select {
  min-width: 260px;
  max-width: 50%;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border: 1px solid #34404a;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #151d24;
  color: #c6d2db;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.golden-picker-notices {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  max-height: 112px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 9px;
  padding: 10px 25px;
  border-top: 1px solid #eec67820;
  color: #d8bc81;
  background: #eec67807;
}
.golden-picker-notices > svg {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  margin-top: 3px;
}
.golden-picker-notices p {
  margin: 2px 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.65;
}
.golden-picker-error {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 10px 25px;
  color: #ffb1a6;
  font-size: 12px;
  background: #ff8d7c0c;
}
.golden-picker-footer {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 15px;
  padding: 16px 24px;
  border-top: 1px solid #283139;
}
.golden-picker-footer p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #c8d2d9;
}
.golden-picker-footer p span {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 5px;
  color: #6f8391;
  font-size: 10px;
}
.golden-picker-load {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 12px 19px;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: #c5f65d;
  color: #172007;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 650;
  box-shadow: 0 0 26px #c5f65d0c;
}
.golden-picker-load:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: #d2ff79;
  box-shadow: 0 0 26px #c5f65d23;
}
.golden-picker-empty {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 25px;
  color: #93a7b5;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.golden-picker-spinner {
  animation: golden-picker-spin 1s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes golden-picker-spin {
  to {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}
html[data-motion='reduced'] .golden-picker-spinner {
  animation: none;
}
@media (max-width: 650px) {
  .golden-picker {
    width: 96vw;
    height: 94dvh;
    border-radius: 14px;
  }
  .golden-picker-header {
    padding: 16px;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .golden-picker-emblem {
    width: 34px;
    height: 40px;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
  }
  .golden-picker-header h2 {
    font-size: 17px;
  }
  .golden-picker-header p {
    max-width: 220px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    font-size: 11px;
  }
  .golden-picker-panel {
    padding: 12px 7px;
  }
  .golden-picker-section-title {
    gap: 4px;
  }
  .golden-picker-section-title > span, .golden-picker-section-title > svg {
    display: none;
  }
  .golden-picker-section-title h3 {
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  .golden-picker-entry {
    gap: 5px;
    padding: 7px 4px;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }
  .golden-picker-entry-description {
    font-size: 11px;
  }
  .golden-picker-marker {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
  }
  .golden-picker-format button {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 3px;
  }
  .golden-picker-ledger {
    padding: 11px 14px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .golden-picker-ledger select {
    min-width: 0;
    max-width: none;
    width: 100%;
  }
  .golden-picker-notices {
    padding: 8px 14px;
    max-height: 90px;
  }
  .golden-picker-footer {
    padding: 13px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .golden-picker-footer p {
    font-size: 11px;
  }
  .golden-picker-footer p span {
    display: none;
  }
  .golden-picker-load {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 40px;
    padding: 10px;
    font-size: 11px;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
}
.criteria-confirmation {
  --criteria-ink: #e7efeb;
  --criteria-muted: #9aacb5;
  --criteria-line: #2a3b46;
  --criteria-accent: #c5f65d;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-height: 0;
  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid #394d51;
  border-radius: 13px;
  background: #0d141a;
  color: var(--criteria-ink);
  font-family: inherit;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 70px #0002, inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff05;
}
.criteria-confirmation *, .criteria-confirmation *::before, .criteria-confirmation *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.criteria-confirmation button, .criteria-confirmation input, .criteria-confirmation textarea, .criteria-confirmation select {
  font: inherit;
}
.criteria-confirmation button {
  cursor: pointer;
}
.criteria-confirmation button:disabled {
  opacity: .5;
  cursor: default;
}
.criteria-confirmation button:focus-visible, .criteria-confirmation summary:focus-visible, .criteria-confirmation input:focus-visible, .criteria-confirmation textarea:focus-visible, .criteria-confirmation select:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--criteria-accent);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}
.criteria-confirmation-header {
  display: flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 15px;
  padding: 21px 24px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--criteria-line);
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% -60%, #c5f65d13, transparent 65%), #111b21;
}
.criteria-confirmation-symbol {
  display: grid;
  flex: 0 0 43px;
  place-items: center;
  width: 43px;
  height: 46px;
  border: 1px solid #c5f65d3d;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #c5f65d0a;
  color: var(--criteria-accent);
}
.criteria-confirmation-header > div {
  min-width: 0;
}
.criteria-confirmation-eyebrow {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
  font-family: ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 1.7px;
  color: #abc881;
}
.criteria-confirmation-header h2 {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--criteria-ink);
  font-size: 21px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -.6px;
}
.criteria-confirmation-header p {
  margin: 6px 0 0;
  color: var(--criteria-muted);
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.criteria-confirmation-count {
  display: flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 5px;
  margin-left: auto;
  color: #b1c2b2;
  font-size: 13px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.criteria-confirmation-count strong {
  color: var(--criteria-accent);
  font-size: 33px;
  line-height: 1;
  font-weight: 450;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.criteria-confirmation-body {
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
  padding: 19px 23px 23px;
  scrollbar-gutter: stable;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
}
.criteria-confirmation-guidance {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px 12px;
  color: #b4c6ce;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.criteria-confirmation-guidance > svg {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  margin-top: 3px;
  color: #d6c487;
}
.criteria-confirmation-guidance p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.65;
}
.criteria-confirmation-guidance strong {
  color: #ebd28f;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.criteria-edit-legend {
  display: flex;
  gap: 11px;
  align-items: center;
  color: #8fa8b4;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.criteria-edit-legend > span {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}
.criteria-edit-legend svg {
  color: #7d9ba8;
}
.criteria-guidance-attention {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 4px 6px;
  border: 1px solid #cdaa532b;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: #c5a75d0a;
  color: #dec085;
  font-size: 11px;
}
.criteria-guide-details {
  margin-left: auto;
}
.criteria-guide-details > summary {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 5px;
  color: #99b3c0;
  font-size: 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  list-style: none;
}
.criteria-guide-details > summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}
.criteria-guide-details[open] {
  flex: 1 0 100%;
  margin-left: 0;
}
.criteria-guide-details[open] > summary {
  justify-content: flex-start;
}
.criteria-guide-details[open] > summary > svg {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}
.criteria-guide-details > p {
  margin: 8px 0 2px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border: 1px solid #344b5a;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: #13212b;
}
.criteria-discovery, .criteria-activity {
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  border: 1px solid var(--criteria-line);
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: #121e26;
}
.criteria-discovery > summary, .criteria-activity > summary {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  color: #c4d8de;
  font-size: 14px;
  cursor: pointer;
  list-style: none;
}
.criteria-discovery > summary::-webkit-details-marker, .criteria-activity > summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}
.criteria-discovery > summary > small, .criteria-activity > summary > small {
  margin-left: auto;
  color: #90a6b1;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.criteria-discovery > summary > .criteria-discovery-warning-count {
  margin-left: 0;
  padding: 3px 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: #b38c3420;
  color: #e7c786;
  font-size: 11px;
}
.criteria-discovery > summary > .criteria-discovery-totals {
  color: #90a6b1;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.criteria-discovery:not([open]) {
  margin-bottom: 13px;
}
.criteria-discovery > summary {
  padding-block: 10px;
}
.criteria-discovery > summary > svg:last-child, .criteria-activity > summary > svg:last-child {
  transition: transform .18s ease;
}
.criteria-discovery[open] > summary > svg:last-child, .criteria-activity[open] > summary > svg:last-child {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}
.criteria-discovery.has-warning {
  border-color: #78653c80;
  background: #332b191e;
}
.criteria-discovery.has-warning > summary > small {
  color: #e7c786;
}
.criteria-discovery-content {
  padding: 0 14px 14px;
  max-height: 240px;
  overflow: auto;
}
.criteria-discovery-entry {
  padding-top: 11px;
  margin-top: 4px;
  border-top: 1px solid #a2bcc41a;
}
.criteria-discovery-entry > strong {
  display: block;
  color: #dce7e9;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.criteria-discovery-entry > p {
  margin: 7px 0 0;
  color: var(--criteria-muted);
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}
.criteria-discovery-entry > .criteria-discovery-warning {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 7px;
  color: #ebd29a;
}
.criteria-discovery-warning > svg {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.criteria-sheet-tags {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 5px;
  margin-top: 9px;
}
.criteria-sheet-tags > span {
  padding: 4px 7px;
  border: 1px solid #314a58;
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: #acc9d5;
  background: #142630;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.criteria-region-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 12px 0 0;
  padding: 10px 0 0;
  border-top: 1px solid #a2bcc41a;
  list-style: none;
}
.criteria-region-list li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 9px;
}
.criteria-region-list li > span {
  flex: 0 0 78px;
  padding: 4px 5px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: #203843;
  color: #9fc2d0;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.criteria-region-list li.needs-attention > span {
  background: #ac813b25;
  color: #e5c486;
}
.criteria-region-list li > div {
  min-width: 0;
}
.criteria-region-list button {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  text-align: left;
  color: #b4d4df;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.criteria-region-list button:hover {
  color: #e2f4f6;
}
.criteria-region-list strong {
  color: #b4d4df;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.6;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.criteria-region-list p {
  margin: 3px 0 0;
  color: #9bb1be;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}
.criteria-list-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  color: #c4d2d8;
  font-size: 14px;
}
.criteria-list-heading strong {
  margin-left: 4px;
  color: var(--criteria-accent);
  font-weight: 500;
}
.criteria-list-heading small {

}

}

}

}
.criteria-activity {

}

}

}
.criteria-confirmation-actions > .criteria-confirm {

}
.criteria-confirmation-actions > .criteria-confirm:hover:not(:disabled) {

@media (max-width: 1100px) {

  }
  .criteria-confirmation-header h2 {
    font-size: 18px;
  }
  .criteria-confirmation-count {

    padding-top: 5px;
    font-size: 11px;
  }
  .criteria-confirmation-count strong {
    font-size: 25px;
  }
  .criteria-confirmation-guidance p {
    font-size: 14px;
  }

    display: none;
  }
  .criteria-discovery > summary > .criteria-discovery-warning-count {
    margin-left: auto;
  }
  .criteria-discovery > summary > svg:last-child {
    margin-left: auto;
  }
  .criteria-card-top {
    padding-inline: 11px;
  }
  .criteria-card-summary, .criteria-source-links {
    padding-left: 40px;
  }
  .criteria-card-summary.has-numeric-badge {
    column-gap: 9px;
  }
  .criteria-numeric-badge > strong, .criteria-range-values > strong {
    font-size: 24px;
  }
  .criteria-context-chip {
    max-width: 170px;
  }

    display: none;
  }
  .criteria-editor {

  .criteria-editor-grid, .criteria-editor-mode {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .criteria-confirmation-actions > .criteria-confirm {
    flex: 1;
    padding-inline: 9px;
    font-size: 13px;
  }
  .criteria-confirmation-actions > .criteria-confirm > svg:last-child {
    display: none;
  }
}

  flex: 0 0 55px;
  color: #88bbc8;
}
.analysis-arc > svg {

}
.analysis-arc-track {

  stroke: #304650;

}
.analysis-arc-value {

}
.analysis-arc.is-complete {
  color: #bce576;
}
.analysis-arc.is-partial {
  color: #dabc85;
}
.analysis-arc-center {

  height: 47px;

}
.analysis-arc-center strong {

  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;

.analysis-arc-center strong > small {

  color: #7896a4;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 450;
}
.analysis-arc-center > span {
  color: #6e8b97;
  font-size: 17px;
}
.analysis-arc-label {
  margin-top: 2px;
  color: #8cabb9;

}
.analysis-map-stat {

}
.analysis-map-seal {

}
.analysis-map-seal small {
  font-size: 8px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.analysis-map-scroll {

.analysis-document-map {

}

}
.analysis-map-region-icon {

.analysis-map-region-copy {

}
.analysis-map-region-copy > strong {

  line-height: 1.4;

}
.analysis-map-region-copy > small {
  color: #85b1c1;

}

}
.analysis-map-region-arrow {
  color: #6d98a8;
}
.analysis-map-headers {

}

  border-radius: 2px;
  background: #92cbd516;
  color: #b5d8e2;
  font-size: 9px;

  text-align: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

  padding-left: 3px;

}

}
.analysis-map-unread {

  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;

  border-radius: 5px;

}
.analysis-map-sheet > footer {

.analysis-map-sheet footer > span {
  color: #7393a2;

  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
.analysis-map-sheet footer > i {

  flex-shrink: 0;

  border-radius: 50%;

}
.analysis-map-legend {

  color: #7f9ba9;
}
.analysis-map-legend > span {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  font-size: 8px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.analysis-map-legend i {
  width: 4px;
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: 1px;
  background: #8bbfcb;
}
.analysis-map-legend > span:nth-child(2) i {
  background: #95a8c9;
}
.analysis-map-legend > span:nth-child(3) i {
  background: #d9b674;
}
.analysis-map-legend small {
  margin-left: auto;
  font-size: 8px;
  color: #63808f;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.analysis-discovery {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 175px;
  height: 100%;
  padding: 8px;
  text-align: center;
}
.analysis-discovery-orbit {

  place-items: center;
  width: 222px;
  height: 154px;
  flex: 0 0 154px;
}
.analysis-discovery-orbit > span {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 14px 0;
  border: 1px solid #77a9b61e;
  border-radius: 50%;
  transform: rotate(-18deg);
}
.analysis-discovery-orbit > span:nth-child(2) {
  inset: 5px 20px;

  border-style: dashed;
}
.analysis-discovery-paper {

  height: 123px;

  border-radius: 7px 20px 7px 7px;

}
.analysis-discovery-paper > b {

}
.analysis-discovery-scan {
  position: absolute;

  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 2px;

  opacity: 0;
}
.analysis-discovery-corner {

  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border-color: #90c1cc;

.analysis-discovery-corner.corner-a {
  top: 4px;
  left: 47px;
  border-top-width: 1px;
  border-left-width: 1px;
}
.analysis-discovery-corner.corner-b {
  bottom: 4px;
  right: 47px;
  border-bottom-width: 1px;
  border-right-width: 1px;
}

.analysis-discovery > strong {
  max-width: 100%;
  margin-top: 9px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #b5d0dd;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.analysis-discovery > span {
  max-width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  margin-top: 6px;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #6f95a6;
}
.analysis-detail-actions {
  display: flex;

  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 4px 7px;

  border-radius: 4px;
  background: transparent;
  color: #8eafbe;
  font-size: 10px;
}

.analysis-detail-actions > button:hover {

  color: #c4dee8;
}
.analysis-insight-drawer {

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;

  background: #1c323e;
  color: #bad6e2;
}
.analysis-insight-drawer header > span {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
}
.analysis-insight-drawer header > strong {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 550;
}
.analysis-insight-drawer header > button {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  margin-left: auto;
  padding: 3px;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: #9ab8c7;
}
.analysis-insight-scroll {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  padding: 16px 17px;
}
.analysis-insight-scroll > section {
  margin: 0 0 21px;
}
.analysis-insight-scroll h3 {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  color: #c8dee8;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.analysis-insight-scroll p {

.analysis-insight-inventory, .analysis-insight-regions {

.analysis-insight-inventory p, .analysis-insight-regions p {

.analysis-insight-regions li > div:first-child {

.analysis-insight-regions button {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  margin-left: auto;

  color: #bad5e0;

.analysis-insight-regions small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 5px;

.analysis-insight-scroll > .analysis-questions, .analysis-insight-scroll > .analysis-warnings {
  padding: 13px;

}
.analysis-insight-scroll .analysis-warnings h3 {
  color: #e3c58b;
}
.analysis-transcript-view pre {
  padding: 13px;
  margin: 0;
  border: 1px solid #3b5562;
  border-radius: 6px;
  overflow: auto;
  white-space: pre-wrap;

  color: #b5cdd9;
  background: #0c171f;

.analysis-transcript-view > small {

@keyframes analysis-wire-flow {
  0%, 15% {
    left: -50%;
    opacity: 0;
  }
  30% {
    opacity: 1;
  }
  85%, 100% {
    left: 120%;
    opacity: 0;
  }
}
@keyframes analysis-discovery-scan {
  0%, 100% {
    transform: translateY(0);
    opacity: .15;
  }
  20%, 80% {
    opacity: .7;
  }
  50% {
    transform: translateY(100px);
    opacity: .7;
  }
}
html[data-motion='reduced'] .analysis-discovery-scan, html[data-motion='reduced'] .analysis-phase-wire::after {
  animation: none;
  opacity: 0;
}

  padding: 10px;
}
.extraction-skeleton i {
  height: 16px;
  width: 16px;

  border-radius: 4px;

.working .extraction-symbol {

.working .extraction-skeleton {

.filter-empty {

}
.inspector {

}

}

.evidence-value strong>span {

.evidence-value p {

}
.evidence-connector {

}
.criterion-match {

}
.decision-line {

.verdict-badge {

}
.verdict-badge.pass {
  background: var(--green-soft);
  color: var(--green);
}
.verdict-badge.fail {
  background: var(--red-soft);
  color: var(--red);
}
.verdict-badge.review {
  background: var(--amber-soft);
  color: var(--amber);
}
.verdict-badge.pending {

}
.human-stamp {

.decision-reason {

}
.source-quote {

}
.source-quote>div {

  color: #9a8dac;
  font-size: 9px;
}
.source-quote span {

}
.source-quote blockquote {

  font-size: 10px;
  color: #aaa3b4;
  line-height: 1.7;
}
.resolve-button {

  width: calc(100% - 38px);

}
.human-note {

  color: #8ca393;

  line-height: 1.7;
}
.resolution-form {

  padding: 16px 19px;
}

}

  padding: 9px;

  color: #7a7186;
}
.form-actions {

  justify-content: flex-end;
}
.inline-error {

}
.error-banner {

}

}
.confirmation-banner {

.confirmation-banner>div:first-child {

  gap: 10px;
}
.confirmation-banner strong {

}
.confirmation-banner p {

}
.confirmation-banner ul {

.results-overview {

.result-bars {

.dashboard-cta {

}
.results-detail {

  align-items: start;
}
.results-detail.has-selection {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 285px;
}
.board-panel {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  box-shadow: none;
  overflow: visible;
}
.board-panel .panel-title {
  border: 0;
  padding: 7px 0 19px;
}
.result-columns {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}
.result-column {
  background: #f1f2f0;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 0 10px 12px;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 260px;
}
.column-title {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 15px 2px;
  color: #8a9a8e;
  font-size: 11px;
  border-top: 2px solid #c4d8cd;
}
.column-title span {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
}
.column-title b {
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: 10px;
}
.result-column.fail .column-title {
  color: #bd9688;
  border-color: #dfbfb4;
}
.result-column.review .column-title {
  color: #bba772;
  border-color: #e2d4ab;
}
.column-items {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}
.column-items .review-item {
  padding: 11px 9px 0;
}
.column-items .item-main {
  gap: 6px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.column-items .item-status {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
}
.column-items .item-main>div {

}
.column-items .item-value {
  width: 100%;

}
.column-items .item-main strong {
  font-size: 11px;

}
.column-items .item-main small {
  font-size: 8px;
  max-width: 140px;
}
.column-empty {
  text-align: center;

  color: #b9babd;
}
.run-footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
  padding: 17px 1px 3px;
}
.result-counts {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
}
.result-counts button {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #9aa199;
  padding: 5px 0;
}
.result-counts .fail {
  color: #b39790;
}
.result-counts .review {
  color: #b1a079;
}
.result-counts b {
  font-weight: 500;
  margin-left: 2px;
  color: inherit;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.run-footnote {
  font-size: 9px;
  color: #a5a5ae;
  margin-left: auto;
}
.text-action {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #93829d;
}
.page-footer {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 9px;
  color: #b6b8be;
  padding: 26px 0 20px;
}
.page-footer>span:last-child {
  color: #bdc0c7;
  letter-spacing: .3px;
}

:root[data-motion='reduced'] *, :root[data-motion='reduced'] *::before, :root[data-motion='reduced'] *::after {
  animation: none!important;
  scroll-behavior: auto!important;
  transition: none!important;
}
:root {
  color-scheme: dark;
  color: #eef2f4;
  background: #090c10;
  --paper: #11171e;
  --ink: #eef2f4;
  --subtle: #89959f;
  --muted: #aab5be;
  --line: #26313b;
  --accent: #c5f65d;
  --accent-soft: #c5f65d12;
  --green: #c5f65d;
  --green-soft: #c5f65d16;
  --red: #ff8d7c;
  --red-soft: #ff8d7c16;
  --amber: #eec678;
  --amber-soft: #eec67816;
  --cyan: #69ddeb;
  --shadow: 0 10px 28px #00000028;
}
html {
  background: #090c10;
}
body {
  min-width: 320px;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: #090c10;
  font-size: 14px;
}
button, input, textarea, select {
  font-size: 14px;
}
button {
  touch-action: manipulation;
}
button:disabled {
  opacity: .38;
}
button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible, select:focus-visible,
.app-shell .doc-preview a:focus-visible, .app-shell .doc-preview button:focus-visible,
.dashboard-modal button:focus-visible, .dashboard-modal textarea:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 4px;
}
::selection {
  background: #c5f65d45;
  color: #fff;
}
* {
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: #394753 transparent;
}
.app-shell {
  grid-template-columns: 240px minmax(0, 1fr);
  grid-template-rows: 64px 1fr;
  background: #090c10;
}
.app-header {
  height: 64px;
  padding: 0 24px;
  gap: 25px;
  background: #0b1016ed;
  border-color: #26313b;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #ffffff03;
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
}
.brand {
  color: #f3f6f7;
  font-size: 29px;
  letter-spacing: -1.7px;
  gap: 11px;
}
.brand-mark {
  color: #090c10;
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  border-radius: 9px;
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 22px #c5f65d15;
}
.brand-dot {
  color: var(--accent);
}
.header-divider {
  background: #2b3741;
}
.header-context {
  color: #a9b4bd;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.header-right {
  gap: 20px;
}
.connection-state {
  color: #aab7bf;
  font-size: 12px;
  gap: 9px;
}
.connection-state.connected i {
  background: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #c5f65d0d, 0 0 12px #c5f65d50;
}
.workspace-avatar {
  background: #1b252e;
  color: #dce8ea;
  border-color: #35434f;
}
.new-review {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #bec9d0;
}
.new-review:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
}
.motion-toggle {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  min-height: 29px;
  padding: 5px 10px;
  border: 1px solid #3b505e;
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: #aabfcb;
  background: #192731;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 550;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.motion-toggle.active {
  color: var(--accent);
  border-color: #6c89454d;
  background: #c5f65d0d;
}
.motion-toggle:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent);
}
.motion-toggle > span {
  width: 5px;
  height: 5px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: currentColor;
}
.motion-toggle.active > span {
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px #c5f65d60;
}
.input-sidebar {
  padding: 25px 16px 20px;
  min-height: calc(100vh - 64px);
  background: #0d1218;
  border-color: #26313b;
}
.workspace-name {
  padding: 0 2px 20px;
  gap: 10px;
}
.workspace-symbol {
  background: #17212a;
  border-color: #2b3944;
  color: #a6bbc5;
  border-radius: 8px;
}
.workspace-name small {
  color: #84949f;
  font-size: 11px;
}
.workspace-name strong {
  color: #ecf2f4;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.workspace-nav {
  margin-bottom: 26px;
  gap: 6px;
}
.workspace-nav button {
  color: #9eafb9;
  padding: 11px 10px;
  font-size: 13px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}
.workspace-nav button:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: #17212a;
  color: #edf4f5;
}
.workspace-nav button.active {
  color: var(--accent);
  background: #c5f65d0d;
  border-color: #c5f65d26;
}
.workspace-nav button span {
  font-size: 12px;
}
.sidebar-section {
  border-color: #26313b;
  padding-bottom: 23px;
  margin-bottom: 23px;
}
.sidebar-title {
  color: #9aabb6;
}
.sidebar-title h2 {
  color: #e5edf0;
  font-size: 13px;
  gap: 8px;
}
.sidebar-title h2 > span {
  color: var(--accent);
  background: #c5f65d0d;
  border-color: #c5f65d2b;
  width: 19px;
  height: 19px;
  font-size: 11px;
}
.icon-button {
  color: #8fa1ad;
  border-radius: 6px;
  width: 29px;
  height: 29px;
}
.icon-button:hover {
  background: #22303b;
  color: #edf6f8;
}
.upload-zone {
  background: #101920;
  border-color: #3e515e;
  border-radius: 10px;
}
.upload-zone:hover, .upload-zone.drag-over {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: #c5f65d08;
}
.upload-zone > button {
  padding: 18px 7px;
}
.upload-icon {
  color: var(--accent);
  background: #1c2a2c;
  border-color: #354e42;
  box-shadow: 0 0 25px #c5f65d07;
}
.upload-zone strong {
  color: #d6e0e5;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.upload-zone button > span:last-child {
  color: #96a9b5;
  font-size: 10px;
}
.upload-footnote {
  color: #8195a2;
  font-size: 10px;
}
.file-list {
  gap: 6px;
}
.file-row {
  border-radius: 8px;
}
.file-row:hover {
  background: #152029;
}
.file-row.active {
  background: #1b2b28;
  border-color: #456035;
}
.file-select {
  padding: 10px 21px 10px 7px;
  gap: 7px;
}
.file-select strong {
  color: #e2e9ec;
  font-size: 12px;
  max-width: 138px;
}
.file-select small {
  color: #90a5ae;
  font-size: 10px;
}
.file-type {
  background: #20303a;
  color: #a2c5d1;
  width: 29px;
  height: 34px;
}
.file-type.xlsx, .file-type.csv {
  color: #a4d98a;
  background: #1c3026;
}
.file-row.active .file-type {
  background: #c5f65d16;
  color: var(--accent);
}
.file-remove {
  color: #8fa1aa;
}
.file-remove:hover {
  color: var(--red);
  background: #ff8d7c18;
}
.criteria-label {
  color: #a3b2bc;
  font-size: 12px;
  margin-top: 18px;
}
.criteria-section textarea {
  background: #091016;
  color: #e0e9ed;
  border-color: #354652;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.85;
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 12px;
}
.criteria-section textarea::placeholder {
  color: #7f95a3;
}
.criteria-section textarea:focus {
  border-color: #95bb51;
}
.criteria-upload {
  color: #b2c0c9;
  font-size: 12px;
  padding-top: 13px;
}
.criteria-upload:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
}
.criteria-upload span {
  color: #879aa6;
  font-size: 11px;
}
.understood-criteria {
  border-color: #26313b;
}
.understood-criteria > button {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.understood-criteria ul, .understood-criteria p {
  color: #becbd2;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.8;
}
.sidebar-bottom {
  color: #9aaeB8;
  padding-top: 20px;
}
.sidebar-bottom p, .sidebar-bottom > span {
  color: #91a4b0;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.7;
}
.sidebar-bottom > span {
  color: #8294a0;
}
.main-content {
  padding: 24px;
  max-width: none;
}
.workspace-intro {
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  gap: 22px;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
}
.breadcrumb {
  color: #8a9dab;
  font-size: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.breadcrumb span {
  color: #526673;
}
.workspace-intro h1 {
  color: #f3f6f7;
  font-size: clamp(24px, 2.4vw, 37px);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -1.4px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.workspace-intro p {
  color: #a6b5bf;
  font-size: 14px;
  margin-top: 10px;
  line-height: 1.8;
}
.intro-actions {
  padding-top: 0;
  width: auto;
}
.button {
  min-height: 42px;
  padding: 11px 16px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-radius: 8px;
}
.button.primary {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #111b09;
  border-color: #c5f65d;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 22px #c5f65d13;
}
.button.primary:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: #d2ff75;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 28px #c5f65d26;
}
.button.primary:disabled {
  background: #36442b;
  color: #93a381;
  border-color: #36442b;
  opacity: .75;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.button.secondary {
  color: #d8e3e8;
  background: #18232c;
  border-color: #374753;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.button.secondary:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: #24333d;
  border-color: #607786;
}
.button.quiet {
  color: #9db0bc;
}
.run-button {
  padding: 13px 18px;
}
.export-popover {
  background: #18232c;
  border-color: #3b4c58;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 40px #0008;
}
.export-popover a {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #e1eaee;
}
.export-popover a:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
  background: #c5f65d10;
}
.ready-note {
  color: #9db0bc;
  margin: -3px 0 20px;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.ready-check {
  background: #c5f65d18;
  color: var(--accent);
}
.ready-note strong {
  color: #d7e8c6;
}
.ready-note button {
  color: #a7bdc8;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.changed-note {
  background: #eec6780d;
  border-color: #eec6783d;
  color: var(--amber);
  font-size: 13px;
}
.error-banner {
  background: #311e20;
  border-color: #8a4b43;
  color: #ffb1a5;
  font-size: 14px;
}
.confirmation-banner {
  background: #242218;
  border-color: #7b6539;
  color: #f1d58e;
}
.confirmation-banner strong {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.confirmation-banner p, .confirmation-banner ul {
  color: #d3c399;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.confirmation-actions {
  margin-top: 16px;
}
.app-shell.landing {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.landing .input-sidebar {
  display: none;
}
.landing .main-content {
  position: relative;
  padding: 58px max(32px, calc((100vw - 1320px) / 2)) 64px;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 83% 16%, #20362a58, transparent 40%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 13% 52%, #0c243841, transparent 43%), #090c10;
}
.landing .workspace-intro {
  align-items: flex-end;
  margin-bottom: 40px;
  position: relative;
}
.landing .workspace-intro h1 {
  max-width: 1060px;
  font-size: clamp(56px, 6.3vw, 82px);
  letter-spacing: -.065em;
  line-height: 1.2;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-wrap: balance;
}
.landing .workspace-intro h1 em, .landing .workspace-intro h1 .accent {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-style: normal;
}
.landing .workspace-intro p {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #a8b9c4;
  margin-top: 23px;
  max-width: 610px;
}
.landing .workspace-intro .breadcrumb {
  color: var(--accent);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  font-size: 11px;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
}
.landing .pipeline, .landing .review-toolbar, .landing .workbench,
.landing .page-footer, .landing .starter-strip {
  display: none;
}
.landing .workspace-intro .intro-actions {
  display: none;
}
.landing-kicker {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 2.2px;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 26px;
}
.landing-kicker::before {
  content: '';
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  background: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 16px #c5f65d55;
}
.landing-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin: 30px 0 24px;
}
.landing-primary, .landing-secondary {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 51px;
  padding: 14px 23px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 9px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 650;
}
.landing-primary {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #162009;
  box-shadow: 0 5px 32px #c5f65d1c;
}
.landing-primary:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: #d7ff89;
  box-shadow: 0 7px 38px #c5f65d30;
}
.landing-secondary {
  color: #e1e9ed;
  background: #172129;
  border-color: #364753;
}
.landing-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: #22323c;
  border-color: #657d8c;
}
.landing-proof {
  color: #92a6b3;
  font-size: 12px;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 18px;
  line-height: 1.8;
}
.landing-proof span {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  align-items: center;
}
.landing-proof svg {
  color: #91b98b;
}
.landing-samples {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
  margin: 24px 0 30px;
  max-width: 780px;
}
.landing-sample {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  text-align: left;
  padding: 19px 20px;
  color: #e7eef1;
  border: 1px solid #34464f;
  border-radius: 11px;
  background: linear-gradient(115deg, #17242b, #101920);
  transition: border-color .18s, transform .18s;
}
.landing-sample:hover:not(:disabled) {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  border-color: #92b76a;
}
.landing-sample > svg:first-child {
  color: var(--accent);
}
.landing-sample > svg:last-child {
  color: #8fa7b6;
  margin-left: auto;
}
.landing-sample strong {
  display: block;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 650;
}
.landing-sample small {
  display: block;
  color: #9eafba;
  font-size: 12px;
  margin-top: 7px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}
.pipeline {
  background: #111920;
  border-color: #2d3c46;
  border-radius: 11px;
  padding: 18px 20px;
  box-shadow: none;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  gap: 6px;
}
.pipeline-step {
  gap: 10px;
}
.step-number {
  background: #19242d;
  color: #8aa2b1;
  border-color: #33434e;
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
}
.pipeline-step strong {
  color: #a6b7c1;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.pipeline-step small {
  color: #7d94a4;
  font-size: 11px;
  margin-top: 5px;
}
.step-trail {
  background: #34454f;
  margin: 0 12px;
}
.pipeline-step.current .step-number {
  color: #152007;
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #c5f65d0b;
}
.pipeline-step.current strong {
  color: var(--accent);
}
.pipeline-step.current small {
  color: #b8ce92;
}
.pipeline-step.done .step-number {
  color: var(--cyan);
  background: #69ddeb0e;
  border-color: #69ddeb45;
}
.pipeline-step.done strong {
  color: #b5d7db;
}
@keyframes stage-glow {
  50% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px #c5f65d0d, 0 0 25px #c5f65d1a;
  }
}
.review-toolbar {
  margin: 24px 0 15px;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}
.view-tabs {
  gap: 21px;
}
.view-tabs button {
  color: #839dab;
  font-size: 13px;
  padding: 7px 0;
}
.view-tabs button.active {
  color: var(--accent);
}
.view-tabs button > span {
  color: var(--accent);
  background: #c5f65d18;
  font-size: 11px;
}
.live-caption {
  color: #a0b5c1;
  font-size: 12px;
  align-self: auto;
}
.live-caption.live {
  color: var(--cyan);
}
.live-caption i {
  background: var(--cyan);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #69ddeb10;
}
.neutral-dot {
  background: #5e7585;
}
.workbench.workspace, .workbench.workspace.detail-workbench, .detail-workbench {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.08fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 18px;
  align-items: start;
}
.workbench.detail-workbench.results {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.source-panel, .items-panel {
  background: #11171e;
  border-color: #2d3b45;
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 24px #0002;
}
.panel-title {
  color: #87a0ae;
  padding: 19px 19px 16px;
  border-color: #263540;
}
.panel-title h2 {
  color: #edf3f6;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 650;
}
.panel-title h2 > span {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 13px;
}
.section-kicker {
  color: #8a9fac;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: .2px;
}
.source-tag {
  color: #b1c3bb;
  background: #17241e;
  border-color: #314e3e;
  font-size: 10px;
}
.source-tag > span {
  background: var(--accent);
}
.source-document-tabs {
  background: #0d151c;
  border-color: #283844;
  padding: 10px;
}
.source-document-tabs button {
  color: #a0b4c0;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.source-document-tabs button.active {
  color: var(--cyan);
  background: #182b33;
  border-color: #365b66;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.review-right {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.item-filters {
  border-color: #27353f;
  padding: 11px;
  gap: 4px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.item-filters button {
  color: #a4b5bf;
  font-size: 12px;
  padding: 7px 9px;
}
.item-filters button.active {
  color: var(--accent);
  border-color: #4a6338;
  background: #26341e;
}
.item-filters span {
  color: #b6c79f;
  font-size: 11px;
}
.item-list {
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 12px;
  max-height: 520px;
}
.review-item {
  background: #172029;
  border-color: #344450;
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 14px 13px 0;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 8px #0002;
}
.review-item:hover {
  background: #1b2932;
  border-color: #63808c;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px #0004;
}
.review-item.selected {
  border-color: var(--cyan);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #69ddeb20, 0 5px 18px #0004;
  background: #172a34;
}
.review-item.pass {
  border-left: 3px solid #8faf4b;
}
.review-item.fail {
  border-left: 3px solid var(--red);
  background: #2c2023;
}
.review-item.review {
  border-left: 3px solid var(--amber);
  background: #28271e;
}
.review-item.fail.selected, .review-item.review.selected {
  border-color: var(--cyan);
}
.item-main {
  gap: 10px;
}
.item-main strong {
  color: #edf2f5;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  max-width: 220px;
}
.item-main small {
  color: #a0b3bf;
  font-size: 11px;
  max-width: 190px;
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.item-status {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 7px;
}
.item-status.pending {
  color: var(--cyan);
  background: #69ddeb15;
}
.item-value {
  color: #f3f8fa;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.item-value small {
  color: #a5bbc7;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 400;
}
.item-bottom {
  border-color: #ffffff0b;
  color: #98acb8;
  font-size: 11px;
  margin-top: 13px;
  padding: 10px 0;
